cvEn: Feliks Tayeb, son of Benyamin and Ju, was born on 18 Shevat 5692 (26 January 1932) in the town of Aryana, in Tunisia. He immigrated to Israel in 1950 and was drafted into the IDF that December. He fell in battle at Shefech HaYarden, near the Sea of Galilee, on 30 Nisan 5711 (6 May 1951), and was buried in the military cemetery in Afula.
